root.label: Excalidraw
root.shortDescription: Open-source hand-drawn style collaborative whiteboard editor and its hosted web app.
root.longDescription: Yarn-workspace monorepo centered on @excalidraw/excalidraw, an embeddable React canvas editor, plus excalidraw-app, the excalidraw.com host adding end-to-end encrypted collaboration, storage and sharing. Core logic is split into layered packages: math for branded geometry primitives, common for shared constants and utilities, element for the scene element model, editing and history, and small single-purpose libraries for fractional ordering keys, laser-pointer strokes and standalone export utilities.

children.label: Excalidraw Web App
children.shortDescription: Hosted excalidraw.com application wrapping the editor with collaboration, storage, and sharing.
children.longDescription: Wraps the @excalidraw/excalidraw editor component into the deployed web app. Adds real-time collaboration over websockets, Firebase and IndexedDB persistence, shareable encrypted links, Excalidraw+ export, AI features, language selection, and error reporting via Sentry. Shared app state lives in a dedicated Jotai store; the Vite config handles build, PWA, and chunking.

children.label: App Shell
children.shortDescription: Entry point, root component, app-wide state, theming, and build configuration.
children.longDescription: index.tsx mounts App.tsx, which composes the Excalidraw editor with collaboration, local persistence, menus, and sidebars. Holds the app Jotai store, timing constants, routes, theme handling, Sentry setup, and the Vite build config with PWA and chunk settings. Also includes a top-level error boundary and a bug-report template.

children.label: app_constants
children.shortDescription: Shared timing, websocket, storage key, and Firebase prefix constants for the app.
children.longDescription: Centralizes debounce and sync intervals (local storage saves, cursor sync, full-scene sync), upload size and cache limits, websocket event names and message subtypes for collaboration, Firebase storage path prefixes, room ID size, and localStorage/IndexedDB keys. Consumed by collaboration, persistence, and theming code so string keys and timeouts stay consistent.

children.label: App
children.shortDescription: Root app component wiring the Excalidraw editor with collaboration, persistence, and UI extras.
children.longDescription: Hosts the Excalidraw editor inside ExcalidrawAPIProvider and loads the initial scene from share links, collab rooms, or local storage. It reconciles and restores elements, debounces local saves, and syncs browser tabs. Also renders the share dialog, live collaboration trigger, command palette, error and overwrite dialogs, and branded menu links, and applies the theme from useHandleAppTheme.

children.label: app-jotai
children.shortDescription: App-scoped Jotai store and atom helpers, including initialization from an initial value.
children.longDescription: Creates a dedicated Jotai store (appJotaiStore) so app state stays separate from the editor package's store. Re-exports the Jotai primitives under one sanctioned import path, which an ESLint rule enforces. useAtomWithInitialValue seeds an atom once in a layout effect, from either a value or a lazy initializer.

children.label: vite config
children.shortDescription: Vite build configuration with PWA, HTML, sitemap, font, and lazy-chunk plugins.
children.longDescription: Configures the dev server and production build: React, SVGR, EJS/HTML templating, type checking, a sitemap built from APP_ROUTES, and woff2 font handling. VitePWA sets up service-worker precaching and a navigation fallback. A custom lazyChunksPlugin finds chunks reachable only through dynamic imports, such as mermaid, and excludes them from the precache. It can also emit their file names as a JSON list for on-demand caching.

children.label: TopErrorBoundary
children.shortDescription: Top-level React error boundary that reports crashes to Sentry and shows a recovery splash.
children.longDescription: Catches render errors and snapshots localStorage contents, parsing JSON where possible. It reports the exception to Sentry with error info attached, then shows a splash screen with the Sentry event ID and a selectable copy of the stored scene. It can open a prefilled GitHub issue, lazily importing bug-issue-template to build the issue body.

children.label: sentry
children.shortDescription: Initializes Sentry error reporting for production and staging hostnames only.
children.longDescription: A side-effect module imported at startup. It maps hostnames to environments and stays off locally, in Docker, or when VITE_APP_DISABLE_SENTRY is set. It tags releases with the git SHA and ignores known noisy errors (IndexedDB closing, stale chunk fetches, quota errors). It captures console errors and feature flags, and beforeSend strips URL hashes so scene data and keys are never sent.

children.label: useHandleAppTheme
children.shortDescription: Hook managing the light, dark, or system theme preference and the resolved editor theme.
children.longDescription: Reads the saved preference from localStorage (default light) and writes changes back in a layout effect. Resolves the concrete editor theme from that preference. In 'system' mode it follows the prefers-color-scheme media query and listens for changes. Returns editorTheme, appTheme, and setAppTheme for App.tsx to pass to the editor.

children.label: app_routes
children.shortDescription: Lists the extra URL paths the app is served on, besides root.
children.longDescription: Defines APP_ROUTES, currently only the Excalidraw+ export path. The service worker navigation fallback allowlist and the sitemap in vite.config.mts both use it. Each route also needs a matching index.html rewrite in vercel.json, which a test enforces.

children.label: index
children.shortDescription: Browser entry point that initializes Sentry and the service worker, then renders the app.
children.longDescription: Imports sentry.ts for its side effects and records a performance mark for startup stats. It exposes the build git SHA on window and registers the PWA service worker via virtual:pwa-register. Then it mounts ExcalidrawApp under React StrictMode with createRoot.

children.label: bug-issue-template
children.shortDescription: Builds the markdown body for a GitHub bug report, including the Sentry error ID.
children.longDescription: A default-exported function that returns a markdown template with a placeholder section for scene content and the given Sentry event ID. TopErrorBoundary loads it lazily as a separate chunk when the user files an issue.

children.label: Collaboration
children.shortDescription: Real-time multi-user editing over websockets with encrypted scene sync.
children.longDescription: Collab.tsx manages room lifecycle, scene reconciliation, cursor and follow state, and exposes CollabAPI through Jotai atoms. Portal.tsx wraps the socket connection and broadcasts encrypted updates. CollabError surfaces connection problems in the UI. A debug hook simulates collaborators for local testing.

children.label: Collab
children.shortDescription: React component orchestrating collaboration sessions, scene reconciliation, and shared collab state atoms.
children.longDescription: PureComponent that starts and stops collaboration rooms, decrypts incoming scene data, and reconciles remote elements with local ones via reconcileElements. Manages collaborator presence, idle state, cursor syncing, and image file uploads to Firebase storage. Exposes CollabAPI through Jotai atoms (collabAPIAtom, isCollaboratingAtom, isOfflineAtom) so the rest of the app can react to session state. Delegates socket transport to Portal.

children.label: Portal
children.shortDescription: Socket.io wrapper that joins rooms and broadcasts encrypted scene and presence updates.
children.longDescription: Portal class owns the socket.io connection, room ID, and room key for one collaboration session. On open() it registers listeners for init-room, new-user, and room-user-change, then sends a full scene sync to joining users. Outgoing payloads are encrypted with encryptData before being emitted. broadcastedElementVersions tracks which element versions were already sent so only changed syncable elements go out; throttled broadcasts cover cursor and idle updates.

children.label: CollabError
children.shortDescription: Warning indicator that shakes and shows a tooltip when a collaboration error occurs.
children.longDescription: Reads an ErrorIndicator ({message, nonce}) stored in collabErrorIndicatorAtom and renders a warning icon wrapped in Tooltip. A useEffect replays a one-second shake animation whenever the message or nonce changes. Bumping the nonce lets the same error message animate again. Renders nothing when there is no message.

children.label: debugCollaborators
children.shortDescription: Dev-only hook that fills the canvas with fake collaborators from a URL parameter.
children.longDescription: The useSimulatedCollaborators hook reads ?collaborators=N in development builds and creates N static collaborators. Usernames come from a lazily imported @excalidraw/random-username, and the first entry is marked as the current user. The result is pushed into the Excalidraw API so avatar and UserList UI can be tested without a real room. Joining a real collab session overwrites these entries.

children.label: Data Persistence
children.shortDescription: Local and Firebase storage for scenes, files, libraries, and tab sync.
children.longDescription: LocalData debounces saves to localStorage and IndexedDB, including library and text-to-diagram adapters, with a Locker to pause saving. Firebase modules store encrypted scenes and binary files for shared rooms. FileManager tracks upload and load status for images. Tab-sync versioning keeps multiple browser tabs consistent; index.ts defines syncable element types and socket payload shapes.

children.label: Data Index
children.shortDescription: Collaboration link handling, syncable element filtering, and shareable-link backend import/export.
children.longDescription: Defines SyncableExcalidrawElement and filters elements eligible for sync, keeping recently deleted ones within DELETED_ELEMENT_TIMEOUT. Generates and parses collaboration links with room IDs and encryption keys. Exports scenes to the JSON backend by compressing and encrypting serialized data, uploading images via encodeFilesForUpload and saveFilesToFirebase, and imports them back by decrypting and decompressing.

children.label: FileManager
children.shortDescription: Tracks fetching and saving of binary image files with pluggable storage callbacks.
children.longDescription: FileManager maintains maps of files being fetched, saved, already saved, and errored, keyed by fileId and version, so uploads are deduplicated. Storage is injected through getFiles/saveFiles callbacks, and status changes are reported via onFileStatusChange. Also provides compression for upload and marks stale image elements as errored through newElementWith and CaptureUpdateAction.

children.label: Firebase Storage
children.shortDescription: Saves and loads encrypted collaboration scenes and files using Firestore and Firebase Storage.
children.longDescription: Parses Firebase config from env and lazily initializes the SDK via dynamic import of firebaseSDK, retrying on failure. Scenes are encrypted and written inside Firestore transactions, reconciling with remote elements, with scene versions cached per socket to skip redundant saves. Files are uploaded to Storage with cache-control metadata and downloaded, decompressed, and restored on load.

children.label: LocalData
children.shortDescription: Debounced browser persistence of scene state, images, and library data.
children.longDescription: LocalData debounces saving elements and appState to localStorage and image files to IndexedDB via idb-keyval, using a Locker to pause saves and updating tab-sync versions after writes. A LocalFileManager subclass clears obsolete files. Quota errors set localStorageQuotaExceededAtom. Library persistence uses LibraryIndexedDBAdapter, with LibraryLocalStorageMigrationAdapter migrating legacy localStorage data.

children.label: localStorage
children.shortDescription: Reads scene, app state, and collaborator username from localStorage, plus size helpers.
children.longDescription: Wraps localStorage access in try/catch so unavailable storage or bad JSON degrades to defaults. Restores appState by merging getDefaultAppState with clearAppStateForLocalStorage output. Stores the collab username under its own key and reports byte sizes of stored elements and total app data.

children.label: FileStatusStore
children.shortDescription: Global versioned store of per-file loading statuses.
children.longDescription: Static wrapper around VersionedSnapshotStore holding a Map of fileId to loading/loaded/error. updateStatuses produces a new Map only when a status actually changes, keeping snapshots stable for subscribers. getPendingCount computes loading versus total counts for progress display.

children.label: Tab Sync
children.shortDescription: Timestamp versions in localStorage that detect newer state saved by other tabs.
children.longDescription: Keeps in-memory timestamps for data state and files and compares them with values in localStorage to tell whether another tab saved more recently. Writes update both storage and memory; reset sets all versions to -1. Storage errors are logged rather than thrown.

children.label: Mermaid Chunk Cache
children.shortDescription: Prefetches Mermaid lazy chunks so the service worker caches them for offline use.
children.longDescription: Reads a meta tag naming the chunk list emitted by the Vite lazyChunksPlugin, waits five seconds so the dialog loads its own chunks first, then fetches every listed chunk at low priority. Runs once per session when a service worker controls the page, and resets on failure so it can retry later.

children.label: TTD Storage
children.shortDescription: IndexedDB adapter persisting text-to-diagram chat history.
children.longDescription: Static class backed by a dedicated idb-keyval store named from STORAGE_KEYS.IDB_TTD_CHATS, storing all chats under one key. Loading returns an empty array on missing data or errors; saving logs and rethrows failures. Implements the TTDPersistenceAdapter shape expected by the TTD dialog.

children.label: Locker
children.shortDescription: Small typed lock registry for pausing operations while any lock is held.
children.longDescription: Generic over string lock types, storing active locks in a Map. unlock reports whether no locks remain, and isLocked checks a specific lock or any lock. LocalData uses it to suspend local saves.

children.label: Firebase SDK
children.shortDescription: Re-exports the Firebase SDK subset loaded lazily by firebase.ts.
children.longDescription: Statically re-exports initializeApp, Firestore helpers (getFirestore, doc, getDoc, runTransaction, Bytes), and Storage helpers (getStorage, ref, uploadBytes). Kept as a separate module so the dynamic import stays out of the main bundle, and static re-exports keep Rollup tree-shaking effective despite Vite's preload wrapper.

children.label: Sharing
children.shortDescription: Share dialog for live collaboration links and shareable exports with QR codes.
children.longDescription: ShareDialog lets users start or join a live session or create a shareable link, with state held in a Jotai atom. QR code generation is split into a lazily loaded chunk to keep the main bundle small.

children.label: ShareDialog
children.shortDescription: Dialog for starting, sharing, and stopping live collaboration sessions and exporting links.
children.longDescription: Renders the share dialog whose open state and mode ('share' or 'collaborationOnly') live in a jotai atom. Shows the active room link with copy, native share, and QR code actions, or offers to start a session or export to backend. Reads activeRoomLinkAtom and CollabAPI from the collab module, picks platform-specific share icons, and tracks analytics events.

children.label: QRCode
children.shortDescription: Renders a QR code SVG for a link, lazy-loading the generator.
children.longDescription: Dynamically imports the qrcode chunk on mount or value change so the QR library stays out of the main bundle. Shows a Spinner while loading, renders nothing on failure, and injects the generated SVG markup with an accessible img role. A mounted flag prevents state updates after unmount.

children.label: qrcode chunk
children.shortDescription: Thin wrapper turning text into QR code SVG markup via uqr.
children.longDescription: Separate lazily loaded chunk wrapping the uqr library's renderSVG. Isolating it lets QRCode.tsx code-split the dependency so it loads only when a collaboration link QR code is displayed.

children.label: App UI Components
children.shortDescription: App-specific menus, sidebar, welcome screen, footer, stats, and AI integrations.
children.longDescription: Customizes the editor's slots with the app main menu, welcome screen, sidebar, footer, and encryption indicator. AI.tsx connects diagram-to-code and text-to-diagram features to backend endpoints. CustomStats adds storage usage to the stats panel.

children.label: AI
children.shortDescription: Wires diagram-to-code and text-to-diagram AI plugins into the app.
children.longDescription: Renders DiagramToCodePlugin, which exports the selected frame as a JPEG data URL and streams generated code, plus TTDDialog backed by streaming fetch and SSE parsing. Persists text-to-diagram history via TTDIndexedDBAdapter and preloads Mermaid chunks when the TTD dialog opens, observed through useOnExcalidrawStateChange.

children.label: AppSidebar
children.shortDescription: App sidebar extending the default sidebar with promo tabs for comments and presentations.
children.longDescription: Wraps DefaultSidebar with extra tab triggers and panels that promote Excalidraw+ features such as comments and presentations. SidebarPromoCopy renders inline SVG illustrations, a free-trial note, and a LinkButton call to action. Reads theme from useUIAppState to adjust visuals, and styling lives in AppSidebar.scss.

children.label: AppMainMenu
children.shortDescription: Hamburger main menu composed of default items plus app-specific links and options.
children.longDescription: Memoized component that assembles MainMenu default items (load, save, export, help, clear canvas) and conditionally shows the live collaboration trigger. Adds Excalidraw+ marketing and sign-in links built from Vite env URLs, a dev-only visual debug toggle via saveDebugState, theme and language selection through LanguageList, and the canvas background picker.

children.label: AppWelcomeScreen
children.shortDescription: Welcome screen with hints, heading, and quick-action menu items.
children.longDescription: Memoized wrapper around WelcomeScreen that renders menu, toolbar, and help hints, a logo, and a localized heading. Signed-in Excalidraw+ users get a heading with an inline Excalidraw+ link produced by splitting the translated string. The center menu offers load scene, help, an optional live collaboration item, and an Excalidraw+ sign-up link.

children.label: CustomStats
children.shortDescription: Adds app version and local storage size rows to the stats panel.
children.longDescription: Injects Stats.StatsRows at order -1 showing build timestamp and hash parsed from getVersion(), which can be copied to the clipboard with a toast confirmation. Uses a debounced getStorageSizes to compute scene and total localStorage usage, refreshing when elements or appState change and cancelling on unmount. Sizes are formatted with nFormatter.

children.label: AppFooter
children.shortDescription: Footer showing the visual debugger controls and the encryption badge.
children.longDescription: Memoized Footer wrapper that lays out a flex row containing DebugFooter when the visual debugger is enabled. It shows EncryptedIcon only for users not signed in to Excalidraw+. The onChange callback is passed through to the debug footer.

children.label: EncryptedIcon
children.shortDescription: Shield icon linking to the end-to-end encryption blog post.
children.longDescription: Renders an external anchor to the Excalidraw+ end-to-end encryption article, wrapping the shield icon in a long Tooltip. Uses useI18n for the aria-label and tooltip text.

children.label: Excalidraw Plus
children.shortDescription: Export to Excalidraw+ and promo banner integration.
children.longDescription: Uploads the current scene and files to Excalidraw+ through Firebase, and provides an iframe export entry point that Excalidraw+ embeds to read local scenes. A promo banner links users to the paid product.

children.label: Plus Iframe Export
children.shortDescription: Iframe bridge that sends locally stored scene data to Excalidraw+ via postMessage.
children.longDescription: Renders inside an iframe embedded by Excalidraw+, posts a READY message, and answers REQUEST_SCENE messages from the VITE_APP_PLUS_APP origin. Reads elements and appState from localStorage via STORAGE_KEYS, loads binary files through LocalData, and replies with SCENE_DATA or ERROR. Typed message unions define the protocol in both directions, and parseSceneData validates the raw strings before sending.

children.label: Export To Plus
children.shortDescription: Encrypts and uploads the current scene to Firebase for import into Excalidraw+.
children.longDescription: exportToExcalidrawPlus serializes the scene with serializeAsJSON, encrypts it with a newly generated key, and uploads the blob to Firebase under /migrations/scenes/{nanoid}. It records version and name metadata, encodes image files with encodeFilesForUpload, and saves them through saveFilesToFirebase, subject to FILE_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES. It then redirects to Excalidraw+ with the id and key. The ExportToExcalidrawPlus card component provides the export dialog UI and analytics tracking.

children.label: Plus Promo Banner
children.shortDescription: Shows a promo banner linking to an Excalidraw+ feature or the CLI.
children.longDescription: Holds a fixed PROMOS list of features (presentations, MCP, comments, teams, voice chat, CLI). Each entry has an icon, translation keys, and a UTM-tagged link built by plusLink from VITE_APP_PLUS_LP. One promo is chosen at random once per editor load and rendered as a link using i18n strings. Promo text is kept short so the banner fits the width of the original button.

children.label: Language
children.shortDescription: Detects, stores, and lets users pick the UI language.
children.longDescription: Uses a browser language detector to choose the initial locale, keeps the current code in a Jotai atom, and renders a language picker list in the main menu.

children.label: language-detector
children.shortDescription: Detects the browser's preferred language and maps it to a supported locale.
children.longDescription: Creates a shared i18next-browser-languagedetector instance and initializes it with empty languageUtils. getPreferredLanguage() takes the first detected language and matches it by prefix against Excalidraw's supported languages, so generic codes like "zh" still resolve to a regional variant. Falls back to defaultLang when nothing matches.

children.label: language-state
children.shortDescription: Holds the app's current language code in a Jotai atom and persists changes.
children.longDescription: Defines appLangCodeAtom, seeded from getPreferredLanguage() at module load. The useAppLangCode() hook returns the language code and its setter, and an effect calls languageDetector.cacheUserLanguage() whenever the code changes. That writes the user's choice back to the detector's caches so it is picked up on the next visit.

children.label: LanguageList
children.shortDescription: Dropdown select that lets users choose the UI language.
children.longDescription: React component that renders a <select> with one option per entry in Excalidraw's languages list. It reads the active langCode and the translation function t from useI18n(), and writes the user's choice to appLangCodeAtom via useSetAtom. The dropdown gets a localized aria-label and accepts an optional style prop.

children.label: Visual Debugger
children.shortDescription: Developer canvas overlay for rendering and saving geometry debug state.
children.longDescription: Renders debug shapes on a separate canvas over the editor when the visual debugger is enabled. Saves and restores debug frames and provides a footer of controls for stepping through them.

children.label: DebugCanvas
children.shortDescription: Renders geometry debug overlays on a canvas and persists debug state to storage.
children.longDescription: Draws debug primitives (line segments, cubic Bezier curves, polygons) and arrow binding fixed points onto a dedicated overlay canvas, scaled by zoom and throttled with throttleRAF. Saves and loads debug frames via localStorage under STORAGE_KEYS. Also exposes a React DebugFooter with controls to step, clear, or close the debugger. Uses @excalidraw/math type guards and @excalidraw/element binding helpers.

children.label: Excalidraw Common
children.shortDescription: Shared constants, utilities, data structures, and types used across Excalidraw packages.
children.longDescription: Foundation layer for the Excalidraw monorepo with no editor-specific logic. Provides app-wide constants, color palettes, font metadata, keyboard mappings, general DOM and string helpers, small generic data structures, and event primitives. Exposed through a single src/index.ts barrel, with a standalone debug helper at the package root.

children.label: Constants & Config
children.shortDescription: App-wide constants, color palettes, font metadata, and responsive breakpoints.
children.longDescription: Centralizes tunable values such as text wrap thresholds, drag thresholds, and arrow sizes. Defines color palettes and dark-mode filter helpers, font metadata with line-height and vertical-offset lookups, and media-query breakpoints plus the EditorInterface and StylesPanelMode descriptors used for layout decisions.

children.label: constants
children.shortDescription: Central app-wide constants for interaction thresholds, cursors, fonts, and defaults.
children.longDescription: Defines numeric thresholds for text wrapping, dragging, arrow sizing, snapping and shift-locking, plus enums like CURSOR_TYPE and font family maps. Re-exports DEFAULT_STICKY_NOTE_BG and draws on COLOR_PALETTE from colors.ts for default colors. Imports element and app-state types only, keeping the module dependency-light so element, math and excalidraw packages can share it.

children.label: colors
children.shortDescription: Color palette definitions and dark-mode color transformation helpers.
children.longDescription: Declares COLOR_PALETTE with shade tuples, picker layout constants, top-pick slots and default stroke/background indexes. Implements dark-mode conversion by emulating CSS invert and hue-rotate filters with a matrix, using tinycolor2 and @excalidraw/math helpers. Results are memoized in a browser-only Map so server-side use does not leak memory.

children.label: editorInterface
children.shortDescription: Responsive breakpoints, editor form-factor types, and user-agent platform detection.
children.longDescription: Defines the EditorInterface type describing form factor, desktop UI mode, touch support and sidebar fit, plus StylesPanelMode. Exports media-query breakpoints for mobile, tablet, landscape, desktop and right sidebar. Browser and OS flags are computed at module scope with guards for missing navigator/window, so the export pipeline can load the module under Node. Persists desktop UI mode under a localStorage key.

children.label: font-metadata
children.shortDescription: Font metrics registry and helpers for text line height and vertical offset.
children.longDescription: FONT_METADATA maps each FONT_FAMILY id to head/hhea metrics (unitsPerEm, ascender, descender, line height) and flags for deprecated, private, local or fallback fonts. Helpers derive the vertical baseline offset and line height used for text layout and rendering. Also exposes Google Fonts unicode ranges and the local font protocol, using FONT_FAMILY and FONT_FAMILY_FALLBACKS from constants.ts.

children.label: Keyboard Input
children.shortDescription: Key and code maps plus helpers for matching keyboard events.
children.longDescription: Defines KEYS and CODES lookup tables and a KeyCodeMap type for layout-independent shortcut handling. Helpers like matchKey, isLatinChar, isArrowKey, and shouldResizeFromCenter interpret keyboard events consistently for editor shortcuts and modifier-driven transforms.

children.label: keys
children.shortDescription: Keyboard key/code constants and helpers for matching events across layouts and platforms.
children.longDescription: Defines CODES (physical KeyboardEvent.code values) and KEYS (logical key values), with CTRL_OR_CMD resolved to metaKey or ctrlKey via isDarwin from editorInterface. KeyCodeMap provides code fallbacks so shortcuts like Z/Y/W work on non-latin layouts, used by matchKey. Also exposes modifier-based predicates for transform behavior: resizing from center, keeping aspect ratio, and snapping rotation to discrete angles.

children.label: General Utilities
children.shortDescription: Miscellaneous DOM, string, date, URL, randomness, and geometry helpers.
children.longDescription: utils.ts is the large grab-bag for DOM checks such as isInputLike and isWritableElement, window lookup, string formatting, and test-controllable date handling. Smaller files cover link normalization and validation, seeded random and ID generation, point sizing, rescaling and grid snapping, and a Bounds tuple with its type guard.

children.label: utils
children.shortDescription: Grab-bag of DOM, string, date, font, timing, and array helpers shared across packages.
children.longDescription: Provides date formatting with a test-mockable clock, string capitalization, and DOM checks for writable/interactive elements and owning windows (supporting editors rendered into other documents). Builds CSS font strings using font-family fallbacks from constants. Includes timing utilities such as debounce, requestAnimationFrame throttling and promises, easing, and array chunking. Imports types from @excalidraw/element and @excalidraw/excalidraw.

children.label: points
children.shortDescription: Computes point-set sizes, rescales points along an axis, and snaps to grid.
children.longDescription: Operates on GlobalPoint/LocalPoint tuples from @excalidraw/math. getSizeFromPoints returns the width/height of a point set's extent. rescalePoints scales one dimension to a target size and can normalize so the minimum coordinate stays fixed, skipping translation for two-point lines. getGridPoint snaps coordinates to a nullable grid size.

children.label: random
children.shortDescription: Provides reseedable random integers, ID generation, and a deterministic seeded PRNG.
children.longDescription: Wraps roughjs's Random for reseedable integers, with reseed() for reproducible tests. randomId uses nanoid but returns sequential ids in test environments via isTestEnv. seededRandom implements mulberry32 for stable per-seed sequences, used for renders that must match across frames and clients. It is chosen because roughjs's generator degenerates for seed 0.

children.label: url
children.shortDescription: Sanitizes and validates user-supplied links for safe use in href and src.
children.longDescription: normalizeLink trims input, escapes double quotes, and runs @braintree/sanitize-url. isLocalLink checks for same-origin or root-relative links. toValidURL turns relative paths into absolute URLs using location.origin and falls back to about:blank when the URL constructor rejects the link, so it is safe for iframe src and anchor href attributes.

children.label: bounds
children.shortDescription: Defines the Bounds tuple type and a runtime type guard for it.
children.longDescription: Bounds is a readonly labeled tuple [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] for the top-left and bottom-right corners of an axis-aligned box. isBounds is a type guard that checks for a four-element numeric array. It lets callers validate unknown values before treating them as bounding boxes.

children.label: Data Structures
children.shortDescription: Generic heap, queue, promise pool, and versioned snapshot store.
children.longDescription: Small reusable containers independent of editor state. BinaryHeap supports priority-ordered processing, Queue serializes async jobs, and PromisePool caps concurrent promise execution. VersionedSnapshotStore holds a value with a version counter so consumers can detect changes cheaply.

children.label: binary-heap
children.shortDescription: Generic array-backed min-heap ordered by a caller-supplied score function.
children.longDescription: Implements a binary min-heap over an internal array, ordering nodes by a scoreFunction passed to the constructor. sinkDown moves a node toward the root and bubbleUp moves it toward the leaves, using a hole-shifting approach that writes the node once at its final slot. Provides push, pop and related operations for priority-ordered processing such as pathfinding.

children.label: versionedSnapshotStore
children.shortDescription: Observable value store with version counter, subscribers, and promise-based change pulling.
children.longDescription: Holds a single value plus a monotonically increasing version, skipping updates deemed equal by a configurable isEqual (default Object.is). On change it notifies persistent subscribers and resolves one-shot waiters. pull(sinceVersion) returns the current snapshot immediately if the version differs, otherwise a promise resolving on the next change, enabling long-poll style consumers.

children.label: promise-pool
children.shortDescription: Concurrency-limited promise runner that collects results in original call order.
children.longDescription: Wraps the es6-promise-pool library, adding missing typings for its fulfilled event listeners. The source iterator yields promises resolving to [index, value] tuples; all() listens for fulfilled events, stores values keyed by index, and returns them ordered once the pool finishes. The listener is removed in a deferred setTimeout after completion.

children.label: queue
children.shortDescription: Serial async job queue running one job at a time in FIFO order.
children.longDescription: Accepts job factories with arguments via push(), returning a promise for each job's result. tick() starts the next job only when none is running, invoking it through promiseTry so sync throws become rejections, and chains the next tick in finally. Relies on resolvablePromise and promiseTry utilities from the common package index.

children.label: Event Primitives
children.shortDescription: Typed emitter and application event bus for decoupled communication.
children.longDescription: Emitter is a minimal typed subscribe/emit primitive. AppEventBus builds on it with a payload map keyed by event name and per-event behavior settings, for example whether late subscribers receive the last emitted value. Other packages use these to communicate without direct imports.

children.label: appEventBus
children.shortDescription: Typed application event bus with per-event cardinality and replay behavior.
children.longDescription: Keys a lazily created Emitter per event name and enforces a behavior map declaring each event as 'once' or 'many' and whether the last payload is replayed to late subscribers. Tracks last payloads and already-emitted once-events. Overloaded on() returns a Promise for awaitable keys (once + replay last), unwrapping single-argument payloads. Uses isProdEnv to gate developer warnings.

children.label: emitter
children.shortDescription: Minimal typed pub/sub emitter with on, once, off, trigger and clear.
children.longDescription: Generic over a payload tuple type, storing subscribers in a public array. on() accepts single or nested handler arrays, filters non-functions, and returns an unsubscribe callback. once() appends a self-detaching handler. trigger() calls subscribers synchronously in registration order. Serves as the building block for AppEventBus and other observable state across packages.

children.label: Types & Entry
children.shortDescription: Shared TypeScript utility types and the package's public export barrel.
children.longDescription: utility-types.ts provides generic helpers such as Mutable, Merge, MarkOptional, MarkRequired, and ValueOf used throughout the monorepo. index.ts re-exports the public surface of the src modules so consumers import from a single entry point.

children.label: index
children.shortDescription: Public export barrel re-exporting all @excalidraw/common submodules.
children.longDescription: Aggregates the package's public API by re-exporting binary-heap, bounds, colors, constants, font metadata, queue, keys, points, promise pool, random, url, utils, emitter, app event bus, editor interface and versioned snapshot store. Also exposes the Debug helper from a sibling debug module outside src. Contains no logic of its own; utility-types is not re-exported here and is imported directly.

children.label: utility-types
children.shortDescription: Generic TypeScript helper types for mutability, optionality, merging and type assertions.
children.longDescription: Provides compile-time-only type utilities shared across Excalidraw packages: stripping readonly, merging object types, marking keys optional/required/non-nullable, extracting promise resolution and Set element types, and deriving callable signatures. Includes a ForwardRef helper built on React.ForwardRefRenderFunction and SameType/Assert for static type equality checks. Several helpers are adapted from ts-essentials and StackOverflow.

children.label: Debug Tooling
children.shortDescription: Development-time Debug class for timing and logging diagnostics.
children.longDescription: Sits outside src and is not part of the main export barrel. Provides a Debug class with static helpers for measuring and logging code-path timings during development and profiling.

children.label: debug
children.shortDescription: Static Debug class that aggregates timing samples and logs performance stats each second.
children.longDescription: Collects named timing measurements into aggregate and averaging buckets held in static records. A window.setInterval logger prints totals, sorted samples, and averages once per second, while a requestAnimationFrame loop counts frames to correlate timings with frame rate. Recording starts lazily on first use and can be toggled via DEBUG_LOG_TIMES; helpers lessPrecise() and getAvgFrameTime() round output.

children.label: Excalidraw Element Core
children.shortDescription: Element model, geometry, editing, rendering and history for Excalidraw scenes.
children.longDescription: Defines Excalidraw element types and constructors, the Scene container and fractional z-ordering, and the Store/Delta history system. Provides geometry, hit-testing, binding and elbow-arrow routing, text layout, interactive transforms, and canvas rendering via roughjs-based shape caching. Used by the editor app and by consumers building elements programmatically.

children.label: Element Model
children.shortDescription: Element types, type guards, creation, mutation, duplication and skeleton conversion.
children.longDescription: Holds the element type definitions and type-check predicates, factory functions for new elements including sticky notes, embeddables and iframes, and mutateElement/newElementWith with version bumping. Also covers deep copying and duplication, programmatic skeleton-to-element conversion, and the package's public index helpers for scene versioning and filtering out deleted elements.

children.label: index
children.shortDescription: Scene version hashing, string hashing and non-deleted/visible element filtering helpers.
children.longDescription: Provides djb2-based hashElementsVersion over element versionNonces and a generic hashString for versioning. Keeps the deprecated getSceneVersion sum for compatibility. Offers filters for non-deleted elements and visible elements, the latter excluding invisibly small elements via sizeHelpers. Accepts maps or arrays through toIterable from @excalidraw/common.

children.label: Element Types
children.shortDescription: TypeScript type definitions for all Excalidraw element kinds and their shared properties.
children.longDescription: Defines the readonly base element shape (geometry, styling, seed, version, versionNonce, groupIds, bindings) and every concrete element type: text, linear, arrow, elbow arrow, frame, image, embeddable, iframe, freedraw and sticky note. Uses branded types for FontString and FractionalIndex, and derives enum-like unions from @excalidraw/common constants. Also declares element map and collection types used across the package.

children.label: Type Guards
children.shortDescription: Runtime type guards narrowing generic elements to specific Excalidraw element types.
children.longDescription: Implements null-safe predicates such as isTextElement, isLinearElement, isArrowElement, isFrameLikeElement and isImageElement that narrow TypeScript types while preserving generics. Covers composite categories like bindable, iframe-like and text containers, plus checks over tool types via ElementOrToolType. Uses pointsEqual from @excalidraw/math for shape-specific checks and assertNever for exhaustive switches.

children.label: mutateElement
children.shortDescription: In-place and immutable element updates with version bumping for collaboration.
children.longDescription: mutateElement applies partial updates in place, recomputing elbow arrow routes via updateElbowArrowPoints and invalidating ShapeCache when geometry or files change. newElementWith returns an updated copy instead. Both bump version, versionNonce and updated timestamp so collaborators can reconcile changes. ElementUpdate excludes id, updated and created, which are lifetime metadata.

children.label: Sticky Note
children.shortDescription: Sticky note styling, geometry, font sizing and hand-drawn path rendering helpers.
children.longDescription: Normalizes sticky note stroke and background colors and keeps bound text ink in sync. Computes seeded, roughened outline points and quadratic path commands with corner radius rules. Fits bound text by stepping font size using measureText and wrapText, adjusting height and bound elements on resize. Also produces footer date labels and routes color updates to the right target element.

children.label: newElement
children.shortDescription: Factory functions creating new elements of every type with defaults applied.
children.longDescription: Builds elements from ElementConstructorOpts, filling ids, seeds, versions, timestamps and default style props from @excalidraw/common. Provides specialized constructors for text, linear, arrow, freedraw, image, frame, embeddable, iframe and sticky note elements. Text creation measures and wraps content and computes anchor ratios; refreshTextDimensions recalculates size after edits. Sticky note helpers normalize style and enforce minimum geometry.

children.label: Skeleton Transform
children.shortDescription: Converts simplified element skeletons into fully formed, bound Excalidraw elements.
children.longDescription: convertToExcalidrawElements accepts ExcalidrawElementSkeleton inputs, the public API for programmatic scene creation, and creates real elements via newElement factories. It resolves container labels, text measurement, arrow start/end bindings to existing or new shapes, frame children and sticky note geometry. Uses a temporary Scene, LinearElementEditor and binding helpers, then repairs fractional indices with syncInvalidIndices.

children.label: Duplication
children.shortDescription: Duplicates elements with new ids, preserving groups, frames, bound text and bindings.
children.longDescription: duplicateElement copies a single element with fresh id, seed and version, remapping group ids. duplicateElements expands selection to include bound text, group members and frame children, then fixes arrow bindings and frame membership and normalizes ordering. OnDuplicateData exposes original-to-duplicate lookups to the host's onDuplicate callback, and reconcileDuplicatedElements merges host edits back. deepCopyElement performs structural cloning.

children.label: Embeddables
children.shortDescription: Parses and validates embed URLs and builds iframe sources for embeddable elements.
children.longDescription: Matches links against regexes for YouTube, Vimeo, Figma, GitHub Gist, Twitter/X, Val Town, Giphy, Microsoft Forms and generic iframe snippets, producing IframeData with sandbox settings. Results are memoized in an in-module cache. createSrcDoc builds inline HTML for script-based embeds, embeddableURLValidator applies host-provided allowlists, and placeholder labels are created with newTextElement and wrapText.

children.label: Capability Checks
children.shortDescription: Predicates telling which style properties each element or tool type supports.
children.longDescription: Simple type-string predicates over ElementOrToolType deciding whether background, fill style, stroke color, width, style, roughness, roundness or arrowheads apply. Used by the UI to show or hide property controls. Sticky notes get background and roughness but not fill style, and the tool-only bucketfill type counts as having a background.

children.label: List Markers
children.shortDescription: Increments list markers in duplicated text elements, like 1., a), or iv.
children.longDescription: Detects decimal, alphabetic and roman list markers in text with regexes, including lone numbers used as step badges, and caps ordinals to avoid matching years. advanceDuplicatedListMarkers computes the next marker for duplicated texts, and applyListMarkerAdvances writes the new text, then refreshes dimensions or redraws the container's bounding box through textElement helpers.

children.label: Image Helpers
children.shortDescription: Loads image files into HTML images and maintains the image cache.
children.longDescription: loadHTMLImageElement wraps image loading in a promise, creating images through the render environment so cross-document scenes keep ownership. updateImageCache loads BinaryFiles by fileId into the app's imageCache and reports updated and errored files. Also filters initialized image elements and validates and normalizes SVG data with SVG_NS.

children.label: +2 more files
children.shortDescription: 2 smaller files in this module.
children.longDescription: elementLink.ts, arrowheads.ts

children.label: Scene And History
children.shortDescription: Scene container, ordering, grouping, selection and undoable change tracking.
children.longDescription: Scene owns the element collection and its maps. Fractional indices keep z-order stable for collaboration, and zindex/sortElements reorder elements. Groups, frames and selection helpers decide membership and what is selected. Store captures snapshots into durable and ephemeral increments, and Delta/ElementsDelta/AppStateDelta compute and apply reversible diffs for undo/redo and sync.

children.label: frame
children.shortDescription: Frame membership, containment, and intersection logic for frame-like elements.
children.longDescription: Computes which elements lie inside, intersect, or fall outside frames using bounds and line-segment intersection tests. Handles binding elements to frames after duplication, grouping elements by frame, and finding frame children and root elements. Collaborates with selection, groups, bounds, and fractionalIndex to keep frame children ordered and selection rules consistent.

children.label: Scene
children.shortDescription: Container holding scene elements, maps, and change callbacks.
children.longDescription: Scene class stores ordered elements including deleted ones, plus cached non-deleted arrays and maps, frame lists, and memoized selected-element lookups keyed by a selection hash. Replacing elements syncs invalid fractional indices and validates them on a throttle in dev and test. Subscribers get notified via callbacks on updates, and mutateElement calls are routed through the scene to trigger re-renders.

children.label: delta
children.shortDescription: Reversible deleted/inserted diffs of elements and app state for history.
children.longDescription: Delta represents paired deleted/inserted partials of an object. ElementsDelta tracks added, removed, and updated elements and applies them to a scene with conflict handling, binding and bound-text repair, and fractional index reordering. AppStateDelta diffs observed app state such as selection and groups. Both support inverse, squash, and applyTo, and are used by the Store and history for undo/redo and collaboration.

children.label: groups
children.shortDescription: Group selection, editing, and membership helpers using element groupIds.
children.longDescription: Pure functions that read and derive group state from element groupIds and appState. Selects whole groups and expands selection from given elements. Resolves the selected group for an element and handles entering group edit mode. Also adds or removes group ids, computes maximum groups, and checks shared membership. Bound text elements follow their containers.

children.label: store
children.shortDescription: Captures scene snapshots and emits durable or ephemeral change increments.
children.longDescription: Store compares StoreSnapshot instances of elements and observed app state to produce StoreChange and StoreDelta objects. CaptureUpdateAction decides when updates are scheduled: IMMEDIATELY, NEVER, or EVENTUALLY. Durable increments go to undo/redo history. Ephemeral increments cover transient changes such as dragging. Snapshots use element version hashes to detect changes cheaply, and an Emitter broadcasts increments to subscribers.

children.label: fractionalIndex
children.shortDescription: Keeps element fractional indices valid and in sync with array order.
children.longDescription: Treats the elements array as a cache of order defined by fractional indices. Validates indices and throws InvalidFractionalIndexError when they are broken. Orders elements by index. Generates new keys between valid neighbours for moved or invalid elements, either mutably or immutably. Bound text elements are kept adjacent to their containers. Uses the @excalidraw/fractional-indexing library.

children.label: zindex
children.shortDescription: Z-order operations moving selected elements forward, backward, front, back.
children.longDescription: Reorders elements by computing indices to move from the selection. Contiguous deleted elements between selected ones are included. Group and frame boundaries are respected so moves stay within the editing group or target frame. Bound text stays with its container. After reordering, syncMovedIndices updates the fractional indices. Also places arrows above the bindable elements they attach to.

children.label: selection
children.shortDescription: Derives selected elements and box-selection results from app state.
children.longDescription: Resolves selected elements from selectedElementIds, with options to include bound text and frame children. Computes elements within a selection box using bounds overlap and BoxSelectionMode. Frames and their children are never selected together. Locked and bound-text elements are excluded from direct selection. Builds stable next selectedElementIds objects, using shallow equality to avoid needless re-renders.

children.label: sortElements
children.shortDescription: Normalizes element order so groups and bound elements stay contiguous.
children.longDescription: Defragments groups by recursing from the outermost groupId inward. Each group takes the slot of its first-seen member, so grouped elements become contiguous while relative order is preserved. Also places bound elements such as text right after their containers. If any elements are lost during sorting, it logs an error and returns the original input.

children.label: showSelectedShapeActions
children.shortDescription: Decides whether the shape properties panel should be shown.
children.longDescription: A single predicate that checks UI app state. The panel is hidden in view mode and while the element link selector is open. It is shown while editing text, when a drawing tool other than selection, lasso, eraser, hand, or laser is active, or when any element is selected via getSelectedElements.

children.label: Geometry And Hit-Testing
children.shortDescription: Bounds, shape decomposition, collision, distance and size calculations for elements.
children.longDescription: Computes absolute coordinates and bounding boxes, breaks elements into line and curve segments, and runs point hit tests and distance queries used by selection and binding. Size helpers handle viewport visibility and aspect-locked sizing. Bucket fill builds fill polygons from surrounding geometry, and visualdebug draws debug overlays of hit volumes and curves.

children.label: bounds
children.shortDescription: Computes element bounding boxes, absolute coordinates, and arrowhead geometry.
children.longDescription: Calculates axis-aligned and rotated bounds for every element type, using roughjs curve path ops for curved linear elements and caching results via ElementBounds. Also derives diamond points, line segments for outlines, and arrowhead sizes including cardinality-style heads. Collaborates with shape caching, linearElementEditor, textElement and frame clipping logic.

children.label: shape utils
children.shortDescription: Deconstructs elements into line segments and curves for geometric queries.
children.longDescription: Breaks rectanguloid, diamond, linear and freedraw elements into LineSegment and Curve primitives, accounting for roundness and corner radius, with results memoized in a WeakMap keyed by element version. Also provides midpoint and snap-point helpers for elbow arrows and binding outlines, and loop detection for paths. Used heavily by collision, distance and bounds.

children.label: collision
children.shortDescription: Hit-tests points against elements and intersects elements with line segments.
children.longDescription: Decides whether a pointer hits an element's stroke, fill, bounding box or bound text, considering transparency, background and frames. Supplies binding-area checks and hovered-element lookup for arrow binding, plus line-segment intersection against rectangles, diamonds, ellipses and curves. Builds on utils deconstruction, distanceToElement and bounds helpers.

children.label: bucket fill
children.shortDescription: Computes the enclosed polygon under a click point for bucket fill.
children.longDescription: Pure geometry for the bucket fill tool: gathers element outlines as segments, splits them at intersections into a planar arrangement, and selects the smallest bounded face containing the click. Returns scene-space points the app converts into a line polygon, or a failure reason. Also decides which elements count as opaque or restylable fills.

children.label: size helpers
children.shortDescription: Size normalization, viewport visibility checks, and shift-locked dimension helpers.
children.longDescription: Provides helpers for detecting invisibly small elements, testing whether elements lie in or fully within the viewport, and snapping dimensions to perfect squares or locked angles when shift is held. Also repositions elements so a chosen edge stays fixed after height changes under rotation. Relies on bounds and SHIFT_LOCKING_ANGLE from common.

children.label: distance
children.shortDescription: Computes Euclidean distance from a point to an element's outline.
children.longDescription: Dispatches on element type to compute point-to-outline distance for rectanguloids, diamonds, ellipses, linear elements and freedraw, respecting rotation and roundness. Uses deconstructed segments and curves from utils plus ellipse math from @excalidraw/math. Consumed by collision hit-testing and bucket fill.

children.label: visual debug
children.shortDescription: Records debug geometry on window for visual inspection of hit-testing.
children.longDescription: Collects lines, curves, polygons, points and bounds into window.visualDebug frames so a renderer can overlay them for debugging. debugDrawHitVolume casts rays from an element's center and plots intersections to visualize its hit shape. Development-only tooling built on intersectElementWithLineSegment and getElementBounds.

children.label: Arrows And Binding
children.shortDescription: Arrow binding to shapes, elbow routing, linear editing and flowcharts.
children.longDescription: binding.ts attaches and detaches arrow endpoints to bindable elements using gap and distance rules. elbowArrow routes orthogonal arrows with heading math from heading.ts. LinearElementEditor handles point editing of lines and arrows, and the arrows folder handles focus-point dragging. Flowchart helpers create and navigate connected node graphs, and arrowEndpointText binds text labels to arrow endpoints.

children.label: binding
children.shortDescription: Binds and unbinds arrow endpoints to bindable shapes and keeps bound points updated.
children.longDescription: Decides binding strategy while dragging arrow endpoints, computes binding gaps and fixed points, and binds or unbinds elements via mutateElement. Uses collision helpers for hover and binding-area tests, and delegates elbow arrow re-routing to updateElbowArrowPoints. Also reanchors bindings to shape outlines and handles bound text resizing on bound elements.

children.label: LinearElementEditor
children.shortDescription: Stateful editor for selecting, dragging, adding and removing points on linear elements.
children.longDescription: LinearElementEditor class holds per-selection editing state such as hovered point, clicked point and dragged focus binding. Handles point dragging with grid snapping and discrete angles, midpoint insertion on straight and curved segments, and coordinate conversion. Calls binding helpers to update bound endpoints and recompute fixed points during edits, and uses ShapeCache and curve math for hit testing.

children.label: elbowArrow
children.shortDescription: Routes orthogonal elbow arrows around bound shapes using grid-based A* search.
children.longDescription: Builds a sparse grid from padded element bounds and start/end headings, then runs A* with a BinaryHeap to find orthogonal paths. Supports user-fixed segments, snapping endpoints to element outlines via binding helpers, and validation of elbow point sets. Produces ElementUpdate objects rather than mutating directly.

children.label: heading
children.shortDescription: Defines cardinal heading vectors and computes headings from points or elements.
children.longDescription: Provides the four axis-aligned Heading constants and helpers to convert vectors to headings, compare and flip them, and test orientation. headingForPointFromElement picks the exit side of a bindable shape using triangle tests, with special handling for diamonds. Used heavily by elbow routing and binding.

children.label: focus points
children.shortDescription: Handles visibility and pointer interaction for arrow binding focus points.
children.longDescription: Manages the draggable focus point indicator on two-point non-elbow arrows bound to shapes. Pointer handlers hover, drag and release focus points, rebinding or unbinding to hovered elements and recalculating fixed points via binding helpers. Moves arrows above their bindable in z-order when needed.

children.label: flowchart
children.shortDescription: Creates and navigates flowchart nodes connected by elbow arrows.
children.longDescription: FlowChartCreator generates new sibling nodes in a given direction, placing them in free intervals and connecting them with bound elbow arrows. FlowChartNavigator moves selection between linked nodes by direction. Relies on newElement factories, bindBindingElement, updateElbowArrowPoints and frame-bound checks.

children.label: arrowEndpointText
children.shortDescription: Anchors text labels to arrow endpoints without moving the arrow.
children.longDescription: Finds unbound arrow endpoints under the cursor for the text tool and computes text bindings, alignment and anchors based on endpoint direction. App-side interaction lives in App.arrowText.ts, while generic binding bookkeeping stays in binding.ts. Uses headings to choose text alignment relative to the arrow tip.

children.label: arrow helpers
children.shortDescription: Dispatches in-progress arrow point or focus point drags on input events.
children.longDescription: Single helper called from App on pointer or keyboard events so that modifier changes immediately refresh an ongoing drag. Routes to handleFocusPointDrag when a focus point is dragged, otherwise to LinearElementEditor.handlePointDragging for point drags. Returns whether the event was handled.

children.label: Text Layout
children.shortDescription: Text measurement, wrapping and positioning of text bound to containers.
children.longDescription: Measures text with canvas metrics and line heights, wraps text with token parsing that handles CJK, and positions bound text inside its container. Caches original container heights so containers can grow and shrink back during editing. Text resizing is coordinated with resizeElements.

children.label: textElement
children.shortDescription: Positions, resizes and binds text elements to their containers and arrows.
children.longDescription: Recomputes bound text bounding boxes after edits, resizes containers to fit wrapped text, and calculates label positions inside shapes or along arrows. Delegates measurement to textMeasurements and wrapping to textWrapping, special-cases sticky notes via updateStickyNoteLayout, and uses containerCache to remember original container heights during resize. Also exposes lookup helpers for container/text relationships and alignment support checks.

children.label: textMeasurements
children.shortDescription: Measures text width, height and line metrics for given fonts.
children.longDescription: Computes text dimensions from font strings and line heights, replacing empty lines with spaces so they count toward height. Width measurement goes through a pluggable TextMetricsProvider (set via setCustomTextMetricsProvider) and an optional RenderEnvironment, allowing non-canvas or test backends. Provides minimum width/height approximations for containers and character-width helpers used by textWrapping.

children.label: textWrapping
children.shortDescription: Soft-wraps text into lines approximating browser line-breaking behavior.
children.longDescription: Splits hard lines into breakable tokens with a unicode-aware regex (falling back to a simpler regex when unsupported), handling CJK and emoji. Assembles tokens into width-constrained visual lines, breaks overlong words, and trims trailing whitespace like browsers do. getWrappedTextLines() additionally maps visual lines back to source offsets for caret placement. Regexes are lazily built and cached; widths come from textMeasurements.

children.label: containerCache
children.shortDescription: Module-level cache of text containers' original heights keyed by id.
children.longDescription: Holds a plain mutable object mapping container ids to their pre-growth height, so containers can shrink back after bound text is reduced. Updated and reset by textElement during text binding and resize; read when restoring container dimensions. Kept as a separate module-level singleton rather than element state.

children.label: Interactive Transforms
children.shortDescription: Dragging, resizing, rotating, cropping, aligning and distributing elements from user input.
children.longDescription: Turns pointer input into element changes. That covers dragging new and selected elements, transform handles and resize hit-tests, multi-element resize and rotate, and image cropping. Align, distribute and grid layout reposition selections. convertToShape recognizes freehand strokes and replaces them with shapes. Arrow bindings are updated as elements move.

children.label: resizeElements
children.shortDescription: Applies resize and rotate transforms to single or multiple selected elements.
children.longDescription: Entry point transformElements dispatches pointer-driven rotation and resizing for single elements, text, sticky notes and multi-selections. Handles aspect-ratio locking, resize-from-center, flipping, font scaling for text, and point rescaling for linear elements. Keeps bound text and arrow bindings in sync via binding and textElement helpers, and mutates elements through the Scene.

children.label: transformHandles
children.shortDescription: Computes positions of resize and rotation handles around elements or selections.
children.longDescription: Defines handle direction types and generates rotated handle rectangles from element coordinates, zoom and pointer type (mouse, pen, touch sizes). Omit-side presets hide side handles for multi-selection, frames, and lines by slope. Decides per editor interface whether side resizing is allowed and whether an element shows a bounding box.

children.label: convertToShape
children.shortDescription: Recognizes freehand strokes and converts them into rectangles, ellipses, diamonds, arrows or lines.
children.longDescription: A moment-based recognizer computes convex hull, principal axes, elongation, skewness and kurtosis of drawn points to classify the stroke. Rectangle vs. diamond is deliberately not rotation invariant. The converter builds replacement elements with newElement/newLinearElement, respects frames and adaptive roundness, and offers a pointer-move handler for live conversion previews.

children.label: cropElement
children.shortDescription: Crops image elements by dragging transform handles, within the image's natural bounds.
children.longDescription: Reuses resize math from getNextSingleWidthAndHeightFromPointer to compute the new size, then converts it into an ImageCrop rectangle in natural-image pixels, clamped to the image and a minimal crop size. Supports aspect-ratio locking, center anchoring and flipped images. Helpers restore uncropped dimensions and remove crop from given sides.

children.label: dragElements
children.shortDescription: Moves selected elements by drag offsets and sizes newly drawn elements.
children.longDescription: dragSelectedElements translates the selection with grid and snap offsets, skipping bound elbow arrows, moving frame children and bound text, and updating or unbinding arrow bindings. dragNewElement and dragNewTextElement size elements being created, applying shift-constrained perfect sizes, center-out drawing and text autowrap thresholds.

children.label: resizeTest
children.shortDescription: Hit-tests pointer coordinates against transform handles and picks resize cursors.
children.longDescription: Determines which transform handle, rotation handle or side edge lies under the pointer for a selected element or a multi-selection bounding box, using side resizing thresholds and editor interface rules. Maps handle types to CSS resize cursors adjusted for element rotation.

children.label: distribute
children.shortDescription: Spaces selected element groups evenly along the x or y axis.
children.longDescription: Groups the selection with getSelectedElementsByGroup, sorts groups by center, and distributes equal gaps across the common bounding box. When groups overlap so the gap is negative, falls back to distributing by centers between the extreme groups. Mutates via the Scene and updates bound arrows.

children.label: positionElementsOnGrid
children.shortDescription: Lays out elements or element groups in a roughly square grid around a center.
children.longDescription: Treats each element or provided group as an atomic unit, chooses a column count near the square root of the unit count, computes row widths and heights from common bounds, and centers the grid on the given point with padding. Returns new element copies via newElementWith; marked as a rewrite candidate.

children.label: align
children.shortDescription: Aligns selected element groups to the start, center or end of the selection.
children.longDescription: Groups selected elements, computes the selection's common bounding box, and translates each group along the chosen axis so its box aligns to start, center or end. Applies moves through scene.mutateElement and refreshes bound arrows with updateBoundElements.

children.label: Rendering
children.shortDescription: Generates and caches rough shapes and draws elements onto canvas.
children.longDescription: ShapeCache stores roughjs drawables generated per element version, including freedraw polygons and rounded elbow arrows. renderElement resolves render state and offsets, keeps per-element offscreen canvases, and draws to canvas or SVG. renderEnvironment hides differences between browser and non-browser Path2D implementations.

children.label: renderEnvironment
children.shortDescription: Defines the host environment abstraction for canvas, image, and path creation.
children.longDescription: Declares the RenderEnvironment type with createCanvas, createImage, optional Path2D factory, and DOM document used for SVG export. Defaults to the browser, but renders and exports can pass an explicit environment to target popout windows, multi-tenant embeds, or Node hosts using node-canvas, @napi-rs/canvas, or linkedom. There is deliberately no process-wide override.

children.label: shape
children.shortDescription: Generates and caches roughjs drawables and geometric shapes for elements.
children.longDescription: ShapeCache memoizes roughjs Drawables per element, built through RoughGenerator using options from generateRoughOptions, which covers roughness, fill, dark-mode colors, and corner radius. Also produces geometry for hit-testing (getElementShape, linear collision shapes) and elbow arrow paths with rounded corners. Freedraw outlines come from perfect-freehand, and line polygon toggling is handled here. Arrowhead points come from bounds.

children.label: renderElement
children.shortDescription: Draws individual elements onto canvas, using per-element offscreen canvas caching.
children.longDescription: Renders each element type (shapes, text, images, freedraw, frames, sticky notes, bound text) onto a 2D context. Elements are pre-rendered to cached offscreen canvases keyed by zoom and theme, using elementWithCanvasCache. Handles opacity and erase states, dark-mode filters, image cropping, render offsets, and position overrides. Uses ShapeCache drawables via roughjs, and creates canvases through the RenderEnvironment.

children.label: Excalidraw Editor
children.shortDescription: Embeddable React whiteboard editor with drawing, rendering, export and collaboration hooks.
children.longDescription: Exposes the Excalidraw React component and imperative API that host apps embed. Combines an App class split into feature mixins, an action system, canvas and SVG renderers, scene serialization and restore, a font subsetting pipeline, and AI/Mermaid diagram generation. State flows through appState plus Jotai atoms. Heavy work such as fonts and the minimap is offloaded to web workers.

children.label: Editor Core
children.shortDescription: Main App component, app state, history, public entry points and shared hooks.
children.longDescription: App.tsx is the central class component.
