children.label: utils
children.shortDescription: Scalar numeric helpers for clamping, rounding, averaging and tolerance comparisons.
children.longDescription: Small pure functions on numbers that the geometry modules share. PRECISION (1e-4) is the default tolerance for isCloseTo. round adds Number.EPSILON before scaling to reduce float artifacts, and accepts round, floor or ceil modes. roundToStep snaps a value to an arbitrary step. isFiniteNumber is a type guard that rejects NaN and Infinity.

children.label: constants
children.shortDescription: Legendre-Gauss quadrature abscissae and weights for n=24.
children.longDescription: Holds precomputed tables of 24-point Legendre-Gauss abscissae and weights, sourced from Pomax's Bezier primer. The curve module uses them for numerical integration, such as computing Bezier arc length. Values are stored as symmetric ± pairs at high precision.

children.label: Points And Vectors
children.shortDescription: Point and vector constructors, arithmetic, rotation, and angle conversions.
children.longDescription: Covers primitive operations that every shape module builds on: creating points from arrays, pairs, or vectors; point equality and rotation; vector add, subtract, scale, dot, and cross products; and conversions between radians and degrees, plus cartesian-to-polar conversion. Results use branded tuples from types.ts.

children.label: point
children.shortDescription: Constructs, compares, transforms, and measures branded 2D point tuples.
children.longDescription: Provides overloaded pointFrom() that builds GlobalPoint or LocalPoint tuples from coordinates, arrays, pairs, or legacy {x, y} objects. Implements equality with PRECISION tolerance, rotation by radians or degrees around a center, translation by vectors, midpoints, and Euclidean distance. Relies on vector.ts for translation and scaling, and angle.ts for degree conversion.

children.label: vector
children.shortDescription: Creates 2D vectors and provides dot, cross, scaling, and normalization operations.
children.longDescription: Defines branded Vector tuples built from coordinates with an optional origin, or from points via vectorFromPoint(), which returns a default vector when magnitude falls below a threshold. Supplies arithmetic (add, subtract, scale), 2D cross and dot products, magnitude, normalization, and perpendicular normals. Depends only on shared types, so point.ts and geometry code can build on it.

children.label: angle
children.shortDescription: Converts and normalizes angles, and compares angular ranges and differences.
children.longDescription: Handles branded Radians and Degrees types: normalizes radians into [0, 2π), converts between degrees and radians, and converts cartesian points to polar coordinates. Also checks for right angles within PRECISION, tests whether an angle lies in a range that may wrap past zero, and computes signed differences clamped to [-π, π].

children.label: Linear Shapes
children.shortDescription: Lines, segments, rectangles, triangles, polygons, and 1D ranges with intersection tests.
children.longDescription: Implements straight-edged geometry: infinite line intersection, segment rotation, point-on-segment and distance checks, and segment intersection points. Also handles rectangle and segment intersection, triangle and polygon containment using both even-odd and non-zero rules, signed area, and convex hull. Range helpers handle 1D interval overlap and intersection. All of these build on the point and vector primitives.

children.label: segment
children.shortDescription: Line segment construction, rotation, intersection, and distance utilities.
children.longDescription: Represents segments as branded two-point tuples and provides type guards, rotation about an origin or midpoint, intersection points, point-on-segment tests, and point/segment distances. Builds on line.ts for infinite-line intersection and on point/vector helpers for cross products and projections. Tolerance comparisons use the shared PRECISION constant.

children.label: polygon
children.shortDescription: Polygon creation, point containment tests, area, and convex hull computation.
children.longDescription: Builds closed polygons by appending the first point when missing. Offers two containment tests: even-odd ray casting and a non-zero winding rule. Also computes signed and absolute area, convex hulls, and simplified convex polygons. Relies on pointsEqual and PRECISION for closure checks.

children.label: range
children.shortDescription: Inclusive 1D numeric ranges with overlap, intersection, and containment checks.
children.longDescription: Models closed intervals as branded InclusiveRange tuples created via toBrandedType from @excalidraw/common. Provides overlap detection, intersection that returns null when the ranges are disjoint, and value inclusion tests. These helpers are used for interval logic such as bounds and snapping comparisons.

children.label: line
children.shortDescription: Infinite line construction and line-line intersection point calculation.
children.longDescription: Defines a Line as a branded pair of points lying on it. linesIntersectAt solves the two-line system with determinants in standard form (Ax + By = C) and returns null for parallel lines. segment.ts uses it as the basis for bounded segment intersection.

children.label: rectangle
children.shortDescription: Axis-aligned rectangles with segment and rectangle intersection tests.
children.longDescription: Represents rectangles as top-left/bottom-right point pairs. A rectangle can be built from min/max coordinates. To intersect a line segment, the rectangle is decomposed into four edge segments and lineSegmentIntersectionPoints from segment.ts is applied to each. Rectangle-rectangle overlap uses a strict AABB comparison, so edges that only touch do not count as intersecting.

children.label: triangle
children.shortDescription: Point-in-triangle test using the signs of edge cross products.
children.longDescription: Implements triangleIncludesPoint by computing the sign of a 2D cross product for each triangle edge relative to the test point. The point is inside when the signs do not mix. The only dependencies are the type definitions for points and triangles.

children.label: Curved Shapes
children.shortDescription: Cubic Bezier curves and ellipses: evaluation, closest points, distances, and intersections.
children.longDescription: curve.ts evaluates cubic Bezier equations and tangents, and finds closest parameters and points. It uses numeric methods with Legendre-Gauss constants and intersects curves with line segments. ellipse.ts tests whether a point is inside or touching an ellipse, measures distance from a point, and finds where an ellipse meets lines and segments. Both rely on the segment and vector modules.

children.label: curve
children.shortDescription: Cubic Bezier curve construction, evaluation, intersection, closest-point, offset and arc-length utilities.
children.longDescription: Builds four-point cubic Bezier curves and evaluates them via bezierEquation. Finds line-segment intersections with a Newton solver using an analytical Jacobian, and locates closest parameters/points for distance queries. Also provides tangents, Catmull-Rom approximations, offset point generation, and arc length computed with 24-point Legendre-Gauss quadrature. Depends on point and vector helpers.

children.label: ellipse
children.shortDescription: Axis-aligned ellipse construction, point containment, distance, and line/segment intersection functions.
children.longDescription: Represents ellipses by center, halfWidth and halfHeight. Tests point inclusion with a normalized equation, and checks whether a point touches the outline within a threshold via distance-from-point. Computes intercept points with line segments and infinite lines. Uses point and vector helpers and the shared PRECISION constant for tolerance.

children.label: Shape Analysis
children.shortDescription: Principal component analysis of point sets for orientation and elongation metrics.
children.longDescription: pca.ts computes centroids, principal axes, and principal coordinates for point clouds. It also orients axes consistently and derives shape descriptors such as elongation and standardized moments, which are useful for recognizing or classifying freehand shapes.

children.label: pca
children.shortDescription: Principal component analysis and moment statistics for 2D point sets.
children.longDescription: Computes centroids and the eigen decomposition of a point set's 2x2 covariance matrix, yielding orthonormal major/minor axes ordered by variance. Projects points into the canonical principal frame to remove translation, rotation and scale, and derives shape metrics such as elongation, skewness and kurtosis via standardized moments. Builds on point and vector helpers from the same package.

children.label: Excalidraw Utils
children.shortDescription: Standalone export helpers and geometric shape utilities for Excalidraw diagrams.
children.longDescription: Published as a UMD bundle exposing serializeAsJSON, exportToBlob and exportToSvg so diagrams can be rendered outside the editor. Also hosts geometry primitives that convert Excalidraw elements into polygons, ellipses, polylines and curves for hit-testing and selection, built on shared math helpers.

children.label: Package Entry
children.shortDescription: Re-exports the public utils API for bundler and browser consumers.
children.longDescription: Small barrel file that defines what the UMD build exposes as ExcalidrawUtils. Forwards export and serialization functions from the main excalidraw package and shape helpers, keeping the public surface in one place.

children.label: index
children.shortDescription: Re-exports scene export helpers and element geometry utilities as the utils package API.
children.longDescription: Serves as a thin backwards-compatibility facade: scene export functions, MIME_TYPES, and export config types come from @excalidraw/excalidraw/scene/export, while bounding-box helpers and the RenderEnvironment type come from @excalidraw/element. Contains no logic of its own, so consumers of the legacy @excalidraw/utils package keep working while implementations live in the core packages.

children.label: Shape Geometry
children.shortDescription: Converts Excalidraw elements into geometric shapes for hit-testing and selection.
children.longDescription: Defines the GeometricShape union (Polyline, Polycurve, Ellipse, polygon) and builders such as getPolygonShape, getEllipseShape and getSelectionBoxShape. getCurvePathOps extracts rough.js drawing ops so freehand and linear elements become curves. Accounts for element rotation and bounds, relying on shared math point and vector utilities.

children.label: shape
children.shortDescription: Defines pure geometric shapes and converts Excalidraw elements into them for collision checks.
children.longDescription: Declares shape types (Polyline, Polycurve, Ellipse, Polygon, Curve) as a GeometricShape union independent of roughjs or element specifics. Converts elements into these shapes: rectangles and diamonds to polygons, ellipses to center/axes form, linear and freedraw elements via roughjs Drawable ops sampled with points-on-curve. Also provides ellipse point tests and segment-rectangle intersection, built on @excalidraw/math primitives and getElementAbsoluteCoords.

children.label: Test Support
children.shortDescription: Helpers shared by the package's unit tests.
children.longDescription: Provides small test utilities, such as custom matchers or fixture helpers, used when verifying geometry and export behavior. Not part of the published API and only loaded by the test runner.

children.label: test-utils
children.shortDescription: Registers a custom Jest matcher for approximately comparing arrays of 2D points.
children.longDescription: Extends Jest's expect with toCloselyEqualPoints, which checks each received point's x and y against the expected point within a tolerance derived from a precision argument (default 2). On failure it renders a unified diff of the JSON-serialized arrays via jest-diff's diffStringsUnified. Imported for side effects only; exports nothing.

children.longDescription: Detected from SDK imports, API hosts, *_URL settings and webhook routes: Sentry, WS Server, Backend V2, Firebase, AI Backend, Library Backend.
